about.title: About
about.heroSubtitle: One house, two practices: private wealth custody for discerning clients, and structured capital for qualified enterprises.
about.whoText: Seated in Zurich, SBDV preserves private wealth with discretion and arranges mandate-aligned capital facilities for qualified enterprises — under documented review, Swiss AML standards, and clear repayment terms.
about.sectionDescription: A Swiss institution built for quiet custody and disciplined enterprise capital — not retail noise.
about.missionText: To preserve wealth and trust with Swiss precision — and to arrange structured capital for qualified enterprises under the same standard of review.
about.visionText: To be the Swiss house clients choose when custody must stay silent and capital must stay disciplined — trusted by private wealth and by enterprises that prefer clarity over chaos.
about.aboutParagraph1: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault is a Zurich-seated institution. We combine private vault custody with a Capital Access Program for qualified operating companies — two practices, one Swiss standard of discretion and review.
about.aboutParagraph2: Private clients come for vault custody or a wealth mandate. Enterprises come for transparent facility structure, KYC/UBO look-through, and a partner portal that keeps the process legible from application to repayment.
about.aboutParagraph3: We do not compete on hype. We compete on documentation, mandate alignment, and the quiet confidence of Swiss operating discipline.

legal.privacyIntro: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault (SBDV), seated in Zurich, is the controller of personal data collected through this website and complies with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) when processing personal data of clients worldwide.
legal.privacyBody:
SBDV, seated in Zurich, is the controller of personal data collected through this website, the client portal, and the Capital Access program. We collect identity, contact, company, beneficial-ownership, and banking data solely to provide vault custody, membership, and capital facilities, to meet Swiss anti-money-laundering duties, and to communicate with you. A request to access, correct, or delete personal data is made through the Contact page.

Data is stored securely, accessed by authorised staff and by banking or compliance partners who need it to perform the service, and is not sold. Hosting and email providers may process data outside Switzerland under confidentiality and security safeguards.

We retain application and KYC records for as long as required by Swiss financial-crime and contractual rules, then delete or anonymise them. A request for deletion is subject to those legal retention duties.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of the SBDV website, client portals, and public application channels. SBDV is seated in Zurich. Swiss law governs these website terms.
legal.termsBody:
These website terms apply to use of the SBDV website, account sign-in, and public application channels. They do not create a vault custody agreement, a wealth mandate, or a capital facility. Vault custody and wealth mandates are provided only under the separate agreement issued for that relationship. Capital Access facilities are governed by the Facility Terms and Conditions, not by these website terms.

SBDV is seated in Zurich, Switzerland. These website terms are governed by the substantive laws of Switzerland, excluding conflict-of-law rules that would apply another law. The courts of Zurich have jurisdiction over disputes arising from use of the website. That does not limit any jurisdiction stated in a facility or mandate agreement.

By creating an account or using a portal you agree to Swiss know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering screening. You must keep your password and any sign-in code confidential. If you believe your account has been used without your authority, tell SBDV promptly through the Contact page.

Enterprises worldwide may apply for Capital Access. Submitting an application is not a commitment to lend, is not a retail consumer loan, and is not a public securities offering. SBDV may approve, decline, or defer an application in its discretion. SBDV may modify the public website by notice on this page. A facility already accepted remains governed by the Facility Terms you accepted, not by a later change to this page.

legal.regulatoryIntro: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault AG, UID CHE-218.964.179, is seated at Bahnhofstrasse 45, 8001 Zurich. It is not a Swiss bank, does not hold a FINMA banking licence, and is not licensed to take deposits or to lend.
legal.regulatoryBody:
Swiss Bullion Depository Vault AG provides bullion vault custody and arranges structured capital facilities for qualified enterprises. Capital Access is not a protected bank deposit and is not covered by deposit-insurance schemes. A company that does not already vault with SBDV may be asked, only after written approval, for a security deposit of 4% of the approved amount. That cash is contractual collateral, not a deposit in the borrower's name at a bank, and not a fee. A client who already vaults eligible gold or silver is not asked for that cash. The advance is limited to 75% of eligible gold and 70% of eligible silver, and the metal stays allocated in the client's name until repayment. The account for any cash transfer is identified in the facility agreement before any transfer. No payment is due to read the terms or to apply.

Private-client wealth mandates are investment programmes, not bank accounts. A stated mandate yield is not guaranteed interest, may be paused or revised, and is not covered by deposit insurance. Bitcoin may be used only as a funding or payout rail; SBDV does not operate a crypto exchange or hold client private keys. Transfers in Bitcoin are irreversible.

All clients undergo know-your-customer, beneficial-ownership, and anti-money-laundering screening consistent with the Swiss Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA). Ultimate beneficial owners are identified to natural persons. Screening applies regardless of the client’s country of incorporation.

Investment and portfolio management services may require appropriate licensing or be provided through regulated partners. SBDV does not claim a FINMA banking licence. Approval of any facility or mandate is discretionary.

Persons and entities in comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions cannot be onboarded. High-risk jurisdictions may be subject to enhanced due diligence rather than automatic refusal.

Risk disclosures: investments involve risk including possible loss of principal. Past performance is not indicative of future results. This website is not legal, tax, or investment advice.

hero.title: Structured capital for qualified enterprises
hero.subtitle: SBDV is not a bank and does not hold a FINMA banking licence. Reading these terms and applying require no payment. A facility exists only after written approval.
hero.eligibility: Operating companies with at least two years of history, audited or reviewed accounts, and a request from USD 500,000. Approval is discretionary.
hero.collateralRule: No payment is due to register or to apply. If you do not already vault with SBDV, a security deposit of 4% of the approved amount is requested only after written approval, and only to the account named in the facility agreement before you transfer. It is not a fee. If you already vault eligible gold or silver with SBDV, there is no cash deposit: the advance is up to 75% of that gold or 70% of that silver, and the metal stays in your name until repayment. Applying is not a commitment to lend.

company.security: After written approval, and only after these terms are accepted, the company pays 4% of the approved amount in US dollars. It is not a fee. The account is named in the facility agreement before any transfer. If SBDV declines before disbursement, other than for breach or a failed compliance check, it is returned in full.

whoCanApply.sanctions: Comprehensively sanctioned persons and jurisdictions cannot be onboarded. Approval is always discretionary.

timeline.title: Indicative timeline

request.attestationsRequired: Please complete all attestations before submitting.
